title: AgroGround: Multi-Granularity Grounded Recognition in Agriculture
abstract: arXiv:2610.04425v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Agricultural visual models are typically evaluated for either recognition or localization, but reliable diagnosis requires identifying what is present and localizing the evidence. Agricultural visual question answering (VQA) datasets carry rich semantic labels but rarely link them to image regions, and adding such annotations by hand is costly at scale. We introduce AgroGround, a large-scale dataset for grounded agricultural recognition: identifying plant diseases and other agricultural targets and localizing their image regions. An automated pipeline converts the labels of eight agricultural VQA datasets into annotations for disease lesions and whole objects, producing 794,850 instruction examples. Healthy images provide negative supervision for disease queries, teaching the model to return empty predictions. translated_title: AgroGround：农业领域中的多粒度定位识别
translated_abstract: 农业视觉模型通常仅在识别或定位二者之一上进行评估，但可靠的诊断需要同时识别图像中存在什么目标并定位其证据区域。农业视觉问答（VQA）数据集虽然带有丰富的语义标签，却很少将这些标签与图像区域关联起来，而以人工方式大规模添加此类标注成本高昂。我们提出了 AgroGround，一个面向农业定位识别的大规模数据集，即识别植物病害及其他农业目标并定位其在图像中的对应区域。一个自动化流程将八个农业视觉问答数据集的标签转换为病害病斑级和完整目标级的标注，共生成 794,850 条指令样本。健康图像为病害查询提供负向监督，教会模型在无病害时返回空预测。我们在已知目标的定位指令与需要……
tldr: 提出大规模农业定位识别数据集 AgroGround，通过自动化流程将八个农业视觉问答数据集的标签转换为病害病斑与完整目标的区域标注（共794,850条指令样本），并利用健康图像作为负向监督，微调视觉-语言模型实现植物病害等目标的识别与定位。
en_tdlr: AgroGround is a large-scale grounded agricultural recognition dataset that automatically converts labels from eight agricultural VQA datasets into 794,850 lesion- and object-level grounding annotations, enabling a fine-tuned vision-language model to jointly recognize and localize plant diseases with negative supervision from healthy images.
